newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-FLEMING STARS AS KENT PILE UP 525.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FLEMING STARS AS KENT PILE UP 525.

text.p: Kent kept up the pressure on the county championship pacemakers by compiling 525 for nine declared against fellow title hopefuls Essex.
Matthew Fleming hit 138 as Kent, two points ahead of fourth-placed Essex, reached their highest total of the season.
By the close Essex had slumped to 80 for five and it might have been worse had Ronnie Irani not been dropped twice off successive balls from Martin McCague who finished with four for 55.
Middlesex captain Mark Ramprakash hit a brilliant 190 to put his side on top against Hampshire at Lord's.
Middlesex amassed 442 for eight before Ramprakash declared, allowing his bowlers to remove two Hampshire batsmen for 69 before stumps.
Worcestershire's Philip Weston completed a superb double century in his side's 551 at Northampton.
Northants ended on 208 for three, still 194 adrift of the follow on.
Championship leaders Gloucestershire finally got their game against Somerset underway late into the afternoon of the second day and were immediately in trouble.
Graham rose took three for 28 from 11 overs as Gloucester crumbled from 91 for one to 119 for four.

Darren Shadford bowled Lancashire to the brink of victory over fifth-placed Warwickshire at Blackpool with a stunning burst of four wickets in 10 balls. Warwickshire will resume on 241 for eight, just 18 ahead.
Lancashire had extended their first innings, 194 for three overnight, to 362 all out.
